# spyro supervisor

Manage Supervisor processes on remote server.

## Before you run it

`status/start/stop/restart/tail` for supervisord programs (e.g. `horizon`). Needs a `sudo = true` profile; a plain app user gets exit 1 ('does not have sudo access').

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro supervisor`

```text
Usage: spyro supervisor [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage Supervisor processes on remote server.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  restart  Restart Supervisor process(es).
  start    Start a Supervisor process.
  status   Show Supervisor process status.
  stop     Stop a Supervisor process.
  tail     Tail Supervisor process stderr log.
```

### `spyro supervisor restart`

```text
Usage: spyro supervisor restart [OPTIONS] [PROCESS]

  Restart Supervisor process(es). Default: all.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --timeout FLOAT     Timeout in seconds (default: 60)
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro supervisor start`

```text
Usage: spyro supervisor start [OPTIONS] PROCESS

  Start a Supervisor process.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro supervisor status`

```text
Usage: spyro supervisor status [OPTIONS]

  Show Supervisor process status.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro supervisor stop`

```text
Usage: spyro supervisor stop [OPTIONS] PROCESS

  Stop a Supervisor process.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro supervisor tail`

```text
Usage: spyro supervisor tail [OPTIONS] PROCESS

  Tail Supervisor process stderr log.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT   Profile name  [required]
  -n, --lines INTEGER  Number of lines to tail
  --help               Show this message and exit.
```
